method: Deterministic node-count stability across repeated mount→unmount cycles of the real app, measured at the single BrowserDOMAdapter choke point (each cycle isolated; gc() between cycles). Node-count drift + post-unmount orphan count are the load-bearing leak signals; V8 heapUsed is intentionally NOT used as a pass/fail signal because it is GC-nondeterministic and noisy in this 2-core VM.
environmentNote: Node + happy-dom. NOT a browser memory profile.
interpretation: nodesCreatedPerCycle is identical every cycle and orphanNodesAfterUnmount is 0 every cycle → mount/unmount neither grows the tree nor strands detached nodes. No accumulation.
